name: Tanisha Kashyap

Career Overview: Tanisha Kashyap is an Indian tennis player starting her professional career with a focus on ITF events.

Playing Style: Displays a solid baseline game with developing power and consistency, suited to hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #552 (October 28, 2024)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #1272 (December 23, 2024)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam; early in her pro career.

Notable Achievements:
  • Competed in $15K ITF events, reaching early rounds and gaining experience.

Other Highlights:
  • A young talent from Karnataka, Tanisha is working to establish herself on the international stage.
